class.name: omnisim_ros2_control/OmniSimSystem
class.description: ros2_control SystemInterface for OmniSim. Reads joint state from the World Harness (GET /robot/<def>/joints) and writes commands to the robot's own bridge (POST /set_velocity for a differential-drive base; for an arm, the streaming POST /servo_joint_positions when the bridge advertises capabilities.servo, else the goal verb POST /set_joint_positions). HTTP runs on its own thread at comms_rate_hz, so read()/write() never block the controller manager.
